channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Kevin O’Connell hires assistant O-line coach to new-look Vikings staff
item.description: Derek Warehime, a longtime collegiate offensive line coach who’s also worked with tight ends, is joining the Vikings as an assistant to new O-line coach Keith Carter.

item.title: Architect turns client when fixing up 100-year-old Minneapolis bungalow
item.description: Bryan Anderson with SALA Architects renovated his Bryn Mawr neighborhood house with his partner and earned a Home of the Month honor.

item.title: Can you tell your fake dates from your golden retrievers?
item.description: If you’re going to become a fan of romance novels, you need to learn the tropes.

item.title: Liam Hendriks’ career comes full circle with return to Twins
item.description: Back with the Twins for the first time in 13 years, Hendriks will try to make the bullpen off his minor league contract.

item.title: Jury sides with Mayo Clinic in prominent physician’s lawsuit over alleged silencing during COVID
item.description: Dr. Michael Joyner sued the clinic in 2023, claiming he was retaliated against for public criticism of the federal government.

item.title: ICE is leaving but the restaurant industry’s problems run deep
item.description: Post-Operation Metro Surge, restaurant workers are looking for guarantees of security and financial help.

item.title: Federal government plans to seize luxury items from convicted Feeding Our Future defendant
item.description: Salim Said owned clothing, watches and purses from luxury brands; prosecutors filed to take the property to pay toward a proposed $7.8M judgment.

item.title: More than 80 Minnesota observers and protesters detail mistreatment by ICE
item.description: The latest testimony adds to an ACLU class-action lawsuit about the conduct of immigration agents.

item.title: ICE surge leaves Minneapolis with staggering economic, societal impacts, city says
item.description: A preliminary city study found 1 in 5 Minneapolis residents are now in urgent need of food assistance.

item.title: DHS says ICE agents suspended for ‘untruthful’ testimony in nonfatal Minneapolis shooting
item.description: The agents’ statements were behind newly dismissed charges against two men from Venezuela.
